---
title: "02 · Tool interfaces and structured outputs"
---

How does a controller turn a proposed action into a validated operation?

## Concepts

Define tool names, argument shapes, and typed outcomes. Schema validation checks shape, and the dispatcher checks access and resource identity. Toolformer studies learned tool invocation [@schick2023toolformer].

## Study task

Run the [tool contract lab](../labs/index.qmd#a-read-only-tool-contract). Add an extra argument to the lookup request and trace the validation error. Sketch the schema for registering a candidate configuration.

## Deliverable

Submit a contract with examples of a successful operation, invalid arguments, denial, and an absent record. State which cases are retryable.

## Companion reading

- *AI Agents in Action, Second Edition*, chapter 3, for tool and server integration through MCP [@lanham2026aiagents].
- *Building Applications with AI Agents*, chapter 4, for designing and integrating agent tools [@albada2025applications].
